preconditions.description: The dimensions of the image must be within the specified bounds.
The starting pixel coordinates must be within the image boundaries.
The new color value must be within the valid range of pixel values.

postconditions.expression: all(image[r][c] == newColor for r in range(len(image)) for c in range(len(image[0])) if image[r][c] == image[sr][sc])
postconditions.description: All pixels connected 4-directionally to the starting pixel with the same color are replaced with the new color.
The output must be the modified image represented as a string.
